output.narrative:
Revenue increased by 30.34 (5.85%) to 548.56, primarily driven by increases in fill_rate (contributing 22.68) and requests (contributing 9.64). Looking into the click-through rate (ctr) anomaly, primary segments driving the shift include ad_format=rewarded (lift 3.88, explanatory power 0.337) and os_version=Android 13 (lift 3.4, explanatory power 0.352). 

Further drilling down into ad_format=rewarded, the movement is concentrated in vertical=gaming (lift 4.96, explanatory power 0.299) and device_model=Pixel 7 (lift 4.33, explanatory power 0.463). Drilling down into os_version=Android 13 reveals concentrations in ad_format=rewarded (lift 3.98, explanatory power 0.353) and region=LATAM (lift 3.11, explanatory power 0.235). 

Segments such as ad_format=video (lift 1.09) were checked and ruled out due to low explanatory power or proportional volume movement.
